get.description: Current human only. Newest-first opaque pagination and 30-day retention. Current channel/history/private-thread access, source deletion and user blocks are rechecked for every item; a page may be empty with a nextCursor after access changes. Contains metadata only, never message content or bot/webhook credentials. Account chat SSE also emits a targeted community_mention envelope through the existing session-protected feed.

post.description: Current human only; marks only their own specified notifications read. Unknown or foreign UUIDs have no effect. Idempotent successful 204 receipt; no message or permission mutation.

patch.description: General team permission. Exact HTTPS public-host URLs, 2048 characters; deletion endpoint has no query/fragment. No URL is fetched. Audio retention is null (unspecified), 0 (no retention), or 1–365 days. Atomic version/idempotency and immutable metadata-only audit.

put.description: Raw static raster bytes, strict container/MIME/dimensions and ClamAV before publication. Icon <=256 KiB/512x512, banner <=768 KiB/2048x1024; global 512 MiB branding quota. General team permission and 20 upload attempts/hour/application. Request body is fingerprinted by SHA-256 for idempotency; bytes are not stored in audit or receipts. Scanner outage fails closed.

get.description: Public applications or current developer/installation participant/the application itself. Contains public profile and policies, never team, credentials or analytics.
Same visibility as application profile; optional current asset fingerprint. Raw scanned image, nosniff/sandbox, private revalidation on each use. Removed/replaced asset fingerprints return 404.

post.description: Configured isolated sandbox only. Human team general action; explicit exact current manifest consent. Creates a disposable community, normal bot/commands installation and three non-login synthetic members through shared domain services. Requires bot identity. Three runs/application, 100/environment; expires after 24h. At most 20 create attempts/application/day. Does not issue a new bot token or widen existing installation grants.

delete.description: Only the creating human with current application general action. Idempotently deletes this fixture community and its synthetic non-login users. Media-room cleanup is leased/retryable outside the database transaction. It cannot select arbitrary community IDs.

default.description: Structured error; 404 outside a configured sandbox

post.description: Performs a real synthetic domain mutation in the caller-owned fixture, producing transactional events. Current community permissions, message policy, intent filtering and redaction still apply. Five synthetic members, 50 channels, 1000 simulator actions/run, 60 attempts/application/minute. Only MESSAGE_CREATE accepts content. Use the existing channel interaction endpoint/client for real typed interaction simulation; do not inject forged interaction envelopes.

default.description: Structured error; 404 outside a configured sandbox

post.description: One-minute shared fault plan, at most five uses. Only this application credential, the exact allowed GET path and X-VoiceRoute-Sandbox-Run header activate it. RATE_LIMIT returns 429/Retry-After, SERVER_ERROR retryable 503, DELAY delays 0–2000ms. No mutation faults, external targets or production activation. Sixteen concurrent delayed responses/node; 20 plans/application/hour. Existing durable subscription test/replay endpoints provide signed webhook testing and concrete-event replay.

get.description: Bot-token lookup for a current community member in an accessible voice channel. Requires a current bot installation and channel viewChannel/connect permissions. Does not require a Gateway session or bulk voiceStates intent. Missing or inaccessible state returns VOICE_STATE_NOT_FOUND.

post.description: Outbound PCM transport without Gateway or human credentials. Requires bot, voice.connect and voice.transmit installation scopes plus current viewChannel/connect/speak. Regular voice channels only. One active connection per application/community; four per application, 5000 deployment-wide and ten creations per minute per application. selfDeaf defaults true and does not mute transmission. Retries with the same key return the same connection and original token; consumed/expired tokens cannot authenticate again. Disabled deployments return VOICE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE. Voice media uses the returned WebSocket URL: IDENTIFY {connectionId,token}, READY, binary 1920-byte PCM frames at 20 ms intervals, END, ENDED after buffer playout. At most ten pending frames and 200 ms native audio buffering; malformed or excessive input emits ERROR {code} then closes. Tokens expire after 120 seconds and are consumed atomically once. Active sockets recheck credentials, installation, permissions and revocation every second with a three-second shared lease; maximum session one hour, idle timeout 30 seconds. Unexpected socket closure revokes the connection.

delete.description: Idempotently revoke the current application connection, remove its SFU participant and clear its voice state. Missing/already removed connections also return 204. SFU failures return retryable VOICE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE; durable removal remains queued. Does not affect another application connection.

get.description: Current manageCommunity permission. Default application audio receive is denied.

patch.description: Explicit administrator human session and current manageCommunity permission; applications cannot authorize themselves. Enables whole-room audio receive for applications that separately have voice.receive scope, listen permission and privacy/deletion/retention metadata. Disabling permanently revokes existing receive session identities, emits stop/state events when reconciled and schedules durable SFU removal. A later re-enable requires a fresh Gateway handshake.

get.description: Authoritative SFU snapshots, metadata only. Current installation, voiceStates installation grant for bots, viewChannel and connect are rechecked per item. A filtered page can be empty with nextCursor; continue pagination. No audio, media JWT or private conversation state.

Pull and websocket creation also accept the application bot token. Delivery storage is independent of the 15-minute Gateway replay window; retained for 48 hours. Claims current authorized events for 30 seconds, 60 pulls/min/application. Retain the idempotency key on network retries. The receipt stores lease IDs only, never interaction tokens. Replay hydrates still-live leases under current ACL and can omit expired/acknowledged or revoked items. Ordering is per resource; ACK unblocks its next event.

Embed.description: At most ten embeds and 6000 text characters across all embeds. Image URLs are rewritten to authenticated proxy resources; outbound fetches are asynchronous, HTTPS-only, DNS-pinned and bounded. No SVG, user credentials or forwarding of request headers.

CommandInput.description: CHAT_INPUT requires description. USER/MESSAGE have no description/options. Personal contexts require a global command and explicit USER installation. Community-scoped definitions accept only COMMUNITY. Unknown fields are rejected.

CommandOption.description: One group → subcommand nesting level; no mixing branches and values. Required values precede optional values. choices and autocomplete are mutually exclusive; bounds must match value type. USER IDs are decimal strings; CHANNEL/ROLE/ATTACHMENT are UUIDs. ATTACHMENT must be scanned and already published in the invocation channel.

InteractionMessageInput.description: Requires nonblank content, an embed, an attachment or a component row. PATCH inherits omitted fields; visibility and reply target cannot change. Mentions default to no pings. HAS_COMPONENTS and LOADING are server-owned. Attachments require the scanned publication lifecycle.

OAuthTokenRequest.description: Use HTTP Basic or client_id/client_secret, never both. Public clients require S256 PKCE. Refresh rotates tokens; reuse revokes the entire grant. Client Credentials permits applications.commands only. ROPC is rejected. Token exchange uses one-shot grants rather than Idempotency-Key receipts, so plaintext credentials are never persisted.

MessageInput.description: Rich application message. EPHEMERAL is unavailable outside interactions. PATCH inherits omitted fields. Reply target is immutable. Components remain interactive without a slash command.

PrivateMessageInput.description: Application DM content/embeds and controls. Community attachments or image resources cannot be declassified into a private channel. Image/file private-context support is in progress. EPHEMERAL belongs to interactions. Human authors cannot publish application controls. Role/everyone mentions are unavailable; user mentions are limited to the private channel owner.
